name: source-head-revalidation-invalid-head-envelope
description: The presented head names the followed source and the seeded chain position, but the accompanying envelope is not a parseable wire DSSE envelope (`payload` is not canonical standard base64). Revalidation must answer `invalid-head-envelope` (§10.5 "Typed outcomes") rather than folding the refusal into `unauthorized-signer` as §10.3 does. The harness must hand this envelope to production parsing as stored -- converting it with `vectorEnvelopeToWire` would mint valid base64 of the garbage payload plus a well-formed signature entry, reach the payload check, and report `head-payload-mismatch`, hiding the envelope outcome. The followed source's high-water mark is seeded at the same chain position, and the harness asserts it is identical after the call: the procedure adopts nothing, so no outcome may advance or clear it (§10.5).
